zoe: noticed invoice-preview for a few EU canary tenants showing doubled token totals during last deploy. small sample shows two enriched events for same req_id with different route_tags.
li: can you paste sample?
zoe: sure:
```
{"req_id":"req_555","tenant":"tn-901","tokens":50,"route_tag":"main","enrich_v":"v1"}
{"req_id":"req_555","tenant":"tn-901","tokens":50,"route_tag":"fallback","enrich_v":"v2"}
```
michael: ledger only has the first event, so preview is overcounting. probably enrichment retries or a re-enrich path. we should avoid changing ledger semantics.
li: short term: hide preview for canary-eu until we get collapse logic. deploy-bot: feature flag invoice.preview.visible=false for env=canary-eu (applied).
zoe: thanks. medium term: emit route_resolution_id on enrichment and let preview aggregator collapse same req+resolution for display only. put this behind a flag and shadow log originals.
michael: add metric meter.preview.collapsed.tokens and tag by env, tenant. billing-bot: ticket BILL-4902 created to track customer outreach and audit logs.
li: ok action items: (1) keep preview hidden for canary until collapse ready, (2) emit route_resolution_id in events, (3) prototype aggregator collapse behind flag + shadow logs. Update this thread when PRs land.
